newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end lower, sedated by drugs.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end lower, sedated by drugs.

text.p: Swedish shares ended lower on Tuesday, partly depressed by a sharp fall in the drugs sector as drugs major Astra dropped and by New York opening lower.
The exchange's general index fell 0.86 percent to 2,651.75 in light turnover of 3.0 billion crowns.

"There was a downward trend in thin trading, but you should not read too much into it," a trader said, adding that prices could very well rebound soon. "Shares that rose the most yesterday, fell the most today."
Astra fell 8.5 crowns to 349.5 on negative U.S. sector trends and profit taking after jumping 11 on Monday.
Rival Pharmacia & Upjohn fell 8.5 crowns to 275.5.
Telecoms group Ericsson withstood negative trends and ended flat at 254, supported by U.S. rival Motorola's better-than-expected earnings report.
Construction company Skanska also did well and rose two to 330.
The forestry sector slipped 0.54 percent after jumping 3.67 percent a day earlier.
Banking group Nordbanken dropped seven to 244 and automotive group Volvo fell 2.5 to 190.5.
